context: Ben → Shirley, after 2nd AC issue at Warm Taipei
text: AC at Taipei — always Mr. Wang first. Mandarin OK. Around $80 emergency call. Don't auth over $200 without warranty check. He's quick, like 2hrs response.
Ito Setsubi is fine in summer but expect 4-6hr response Dec through Feb. If it's a cold-snap pipe burst and guest is in the house, jump to my private contact list — don't wait on Setsubi.

Yosemite lockouts: don't dispatch a locksmith first. The Schlage code rotates daily — push the code via the app, then call to confirm. Locksmith is the $200+ fallback if the lock itself failed. Guests at Creekfront are usually fine to wait 15 min.

Reno checkout is 11am, cleaner needs 90 min minimum. If a guest extends checkout past 11:30 we need to charge them at least an hour late-checkout fee — otherwise the cleaner cascades into the next check-in and we end up comping the new guest.

context: Ben → Celine, drafting the Bali villa SOP
text: For Bali plumbing always use the local kampung plumber first, not the resort-area company. Local guy is $30 a call, knows the building. The resort company is $150 minimum and they show up an hour late. Only escalate to them if it's a sewage main thing.
